title: Settings written during a session are not picked up: a new project .claude/settings.json allow rule keeps prompting until restart
observed: kiln defect (parity). In-session, Opus wrote .claude/settings.json with allow ['Bash(go test *)','Bash(go build *)'] (approved at the protected-path prompt). Later in the same session 'go test -count=1 ./...' and 'go build ./...' still prompted, offering 'don't ask again for: go test *' (prompts.log t5b, t6c-4, t7-2/3). No settings watcher exists in internal/ (grep for fsnotify/reload found none). See the follow-up resume check in the report.
expected: Claude Code watches its settings files (src/utils/settings/changeDetector.ts, chokidar) and applies changes mid-session. kiln should reload settings when a settings file changes, or at least tell the user a restart is needed.

fix.note: 7cf8be8 on branch worktree-agent-ae1e528c60b007fe6 (not merged; unit tests only). Permission rules reload; mode, model, env, hooks, sandbox and autoMode still need a restart. Earlier note: the rule applied after a restart (kiln -c, 16:43).
